headline: A terrible picture in Antalya: '155 bankruptcies, 350 composition agreements'
summary: Antalya ATSO presidential candidate Davut Çetin highlighted 155 bankruptcies and 350 composition agreements in the city's economy. He made the comments while announcing his '7 Themes 50 Projects' programme.
why: Bankruptcy and composition filings are indicators of business distress, which matter for credit risk and local economic health.
